title: Sharing Miles Added for Drivers Named on a Car Rental Agreement
content:
Drivers named on an agreement of the Car Rental Rate Classes add a sharing allowance to the mileage granted on it. The drivers counted are the additional driver lines standing on the rental's ledger, taken together with the number of days the allowance is granted for.

**The sharing schedule.**

| What stands on the rental's ledger, and the days granted for | Miles added |
|---|---|
| Two or more additional driver lines, the allowance granted for 7 or more days | 180 |
| One additional driver line, the allowance granted for 7 or more days | 90 |
| Anything else | Nothing on that account |

**Both parts of each condition.** Each of the first two entitlements requires the driver lines and the days granted for together. Two additional driver lines on an allowance granted for 6 days add nothing; three additional driver lines on an allowance granted for 7 days add 180. One additional driver line on an allowance granted for 7 days adds 90; the same line on an allowance granted for 5 days adds nothing. No additional driver line at all adds nothing, however many days the allowance is granted for.

**The boundary on the days.** At exactly 7 days granted for, the entitlement stands; at 6 days granted for it does not.
